messages:
ana: Short postmortem follow-up from today's DR run. Root causes: aggressive route withdrawal in us-east, stale backup manifests for one AZ, and a couple manual restore steps that added time. I'll list owners + ETAs.

tom: I'll own R-1 (withdraw tuning + deploy gate). Plan: add 10s withdraw-grace, extend healthcheck window, and a deploy-sim test. ETA 2026-04-10 OPS-7210.

rui: I'll take R-2 (backup manifest audit + quick-restore). Add hourly manifest checksum and a weekday quick-restore smoke to staging. ETA 2026-03-29 job=JENK-334.

kevin: I'll take R-3 (restore runbook cleanup). Add pre-restore checklist (snapshots, KMS, VIP bind), and script the VIP rebind. Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore ETA 2026-04-02.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach runbook-lint results before closing docs ticket.

ana: proposed drills: tabletop 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC (30m) to walk checklist, warm failover eu-west 2026-04-20 14:00 UTC (2h). calendar-bot: events created.

tom: small config snippet for RFC:
```bash
bgp withdraw-grace 10
set healthcheck timeout 12s
```

rui: tagging telemetry failure_mode=partial-withdraw so we can track recurrence. Will add dashboard and weekly digest to #incidents.

ana: action tracker snapshot:
- R-1 withdraw tuning: owner=tom ETA=2026-04-10 ticket=OPS-7210
- R-2 backup verify: owner=rui ETA=2026-03-29 job=JENK-334
- R-3 runbook: owner=kevin ETA=2026-04-02 doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore

ana: please update here as you make progress. I'll post a Monday roundup until items are closed.

tom: ack :thumbsup:

rui: ack

kevin: ack

ana: closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear.
